design.component_amplitude: A_TONE = sqrt(2) per component (unit power); the imbalance arm scales the band-5 component to amp 3 (power 9)
design.r_normalisation: r32 = ||P_b ser||^2 / ||P_b y_b||^2 with y_b a unit-power tone at b (= unit_band_power) -- the literal 32-sample read-out used in prior probes; its rectangular-window main lobe is +-1 band wide, so off-grid (misrouted) energy leaks into neighbouring integer bands (see r32_leakage_of_pure_arms).  S128 = the 128-sample fine-spectrum power at the exact band (head_direction.spectrum_at), ~4x narrower, used for the verdicts.  Both are normalised so a unit-power tone at b reads 1; the 'own-energy fraction' of a component of amplitude a is r/a^2
design.fine_spectrum: S(f) = ||P_f ser||^2/L on SPEC_GRID (0.5..9.0 step 0.05); a unit-power tone reads 1 at its own band
design.n_carrier: first PC of the uncentred pure-null state set {h(5,phi),h(6,phi)} over state_predicts.PHASES, sign-fixed onto the mean null state (state_predicts.null_geometry, reused verbatim)
design.state_additivity: compare h_mix with sum_b a_b h(b,phi_b) - (sum_b a_b - 1) h(0), and the same on the 128-sample forecast; cos and relative residual

P1_component_wise.note: trained component preserved, null component fails -> the failure is per-component; check whether the trained S128 equals 1 exactly (interaction) in the report

P4_imbalance.note: falsification would be the band-4 read-out dropping relative to the pure arm

P5_nondegenerate_control.note: 5.3 works alone (S128~1); if it also works inside the mixture the failure is a property of the degenerate slice
